sections.title: Accessories
sections.note: 28 accessories; the Survey Binoculars and Curious Charm replace the Scope and Ancient Charm.

items.name: Zora's Flippers
items.howTo: Buy for 350 Rupees.

items.name: Zora Scale
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'The Zora Child's Fate'.
items.after: After Chaos at River Zora Village

items.name: Gerudo Sandals
items.howTo: Buy for 400 Rupees.

items.name: Gold Sash
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Wild Sandstorms'.

items.name: Climbing Band
items.howTo: Buy for 500 Rupees.

items.name: Goron's Bracelet
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'A Mountainous Mystery'.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano

items.name: Spin Brace
items.area: East Ruins (cave east of Scrubton, northeast Faron Wetlands)
items.howTo: Treasure Chest guarded by a Darknut Lv. 3.

items.name: Ice Spikes
items.howTo: Treasure Chest that appears after defeating the group of ice enemies in the cave.

items.name: Frog Ring
items.howTo: Treasure Chest in the northeast room with three chests on B2 of the Hyrule Castle dungeon.

items.name: Charging Horn
items.howTo: Clear the Flag Race Long Course in under 40 seconds.

items.name: Stone Anklet
items.howTo: Buy for 400 Rupees.

items.name: Clockwork Bangle
items.howTo: After building all six Automatons, talk to Dampé.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: Dampé asks 5 Monster Stones for it. Game8's checklist instead lists '5 Monster Stones' as the reward for all Automatons; unverified.

items.name: First Mastery
items.howTo: Clear 4 different Slumber Dojo challenges.

items.name: Second Mastery
items.howTo: Clear 8 different Slumber Dojo challenges.

items.name: Final Mastery
items.howTo: Clear 14 different Slumber Dojo challenges.

items.name: Might Bell
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'The Great Fairy's Request'.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano

items.name: Heart Pin
items.howTo: Treasure Chest on 2F of the Suthorn Ruins.

items.name: Heart Barrette
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Beetle Ballyhoo'.

items.name: Silver Brooch
items.area: Cliff west of the River Zora Village waypoint
items.howTo: Climb the cliff west of the River Zora Village waypoint and blow open the cracked wall (Bombfish or Bombs of Might); chest inside.

items.name: Gold Brooch
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Secret Chief Talks'.

items.name: Energy Glove
items.howTo: Treasure Chest guarded by several Boarblins.

items.name: Energy Belt
items.area: Cave north of the Moblin camp, eastern Hebra Mountain
items.howTo: Melt the ice in the cave; Treasure Chest guarded by a Sword Moblin Lv. 3.

items.name: Survey Scope
items.howTo: 'Recipes, Please!': register 10 different smoothie recipes.
items.notes: Replaced by the Survey Binoculars when you get them.

items.name: Survey Binoculars
items.howTo: 'Recipes, Please!': register 30 different recipes in total.

items.name: Fairy Flower
items.area: Hidden cave in southwestern Eldin Volcano
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall near the western Eldin Volcano waypoint (Bombfish); chest inside.

items.name: Fairy Fragrance
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Looking for Bempu'.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: Ancient Charm
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Let's Play a Game'.
items.notes: Replaced by the Curious Charm when you get it.

items.name: Curious Charm
items.howTo: Reward for the side quest 'Cotton-Candy Hunt'.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

sections.title: Great Fairy accessory slots
sections.note: Zelda starts with 1 slot; the Great Fairy on the island in Lake Hylia sells 4 more.

items.name: 2nd accessory slot
items.howTo: Pay the Great Fairy 100 Rupees.

items.name: 3rd accessory slot
items.howTo: Pay the Great Fairy 300 Rupees.

items.name: 4th accessory slot
items.howTo: Pay the Great Fairy 500 Rupees.

items.name: 5th accessory slot
items.howTo: Pay the Great Fairy 1000 Rupees.
